'''Prat''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|Watch Captain]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Watch Captain Prat was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Prat was added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Lost Star Destroyer|"Star Destroyer" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:SD" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 8 Notes for Jan 15 2008|"Chapter 8" update]], on [[January 15]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 8: The Nova Orion Crisis">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67563&month=012008|text=Chapter 8: The Nova Orion Crisis}}</ref>
